verses.original: וַיִּקָּ֨הֲל֜וּ כָּל־ עֲדַ֤ת בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ שִׁלֹ֔ה וַיַּשְׁכִּ֥ינוּ שָׁ֖ם אֶת־ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְהָאָ֥רֶץ נִכְבְּשָׁ֖ה לִפְנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qā·hă·lū kāl- ‘ă·ḏaṯ bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl ši·lōh way·yaš·kî·nū šām ’eṯ- ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ wə·hā·’ā·reṣ niḵ·bə·šāh lip̄·nê·hem
verses.literal: Then the whole congregation . . . of Israel assembled at Shiloh and set up the Tent of Meeting there And though the land was subdued before them
verses.literalPt: E TODA a congregação dos filhos de Israel se reuniu em Siló, e ali armaram a tenda da congregação, depois que a terra lhes foi sujeita.

verses.original: וַיִּוָּֽתְרוּ֙ בִּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־ חָלְק֖וּ אֶת־ נַֽחֲלָתָ֑ם שִׁבְעָ֖ה שְׁבָטִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiw·wā·ṯə·rū biḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·šer lō- ḥā·lə·qū ’eṯ- na·ḥă·lā·ṯām šiḇ·‘āh šə·ḇā·ṭîm
verses.literal: there were still seven tribes of Israel who had not yet received their inheritance
verses.literalPt: E dentre os filhos de Israel ficaram sete tribos que ainda não tinham repartido a sua herança.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל עַד־ אָ֙נָה֙ אַתֶּ֣ם מִתְרַפִּ֔ים לָבוֹא֙ לָרֶ֣שֶׁת אֶת־ הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר֙ נָתַ֣ן לָכֶ֔ם יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ‘aḏ- ’ā·nāh ’at·tem miṯ·rap·pîm lā·ḇō·w lā·re·šeṯ ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer nā·ṯan lā·ḵem Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·ḵem
verses.literal: So Joshua said to the Israelites . . . How long . . . will you put off entering and possessing the land that the LORD the God of your fathers has given you
verses.literalPt: E disse Josué aos filhos de Israel: Até quando sereis negligentes em chegardes para possuir a terra que o SENHOR Deus de vossos pais vos deu?

verses.original: הָב֥וּ לָכֶ֛ם שְׁלֹשָׁ֥ה אֲנָשִׁ֖ים לַשָּׁ֑בֶט וְאֶשְׁלָחֵ֗ם וְיָקֻ֜מוּ וְיִֽתְהַלְּכ֥וּ בָאָ֛רֶץ וְיִכְתְּב֥וּ אוֹתָ֛הּ לְפִ֥י נַֽחֲלָתָ֖ם וְיָבֹ֥אוּ אֵלָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: hā·ḇū lā·ḵem šə·lō·šāh ’ă·nā·šîm laš·šā·ḇeṭ wə·’eš·lā·ḥêm wə·yā·qu·mū wə·yiṯ·hal·lə·ḵū ḇā·’ā·reṣ wə·yiḵ·tə·ḇū ’ō·w·ṯāh lə·p̄î na·ḥă·lā·ṯām wə·yā·ḇō·’ū ’ê·lāy
verses.literal: Appoint three men from each tribe and I will send them out . . . to survey the land and map it out according to the inheritance of each Then they will return to me
verses.literalPt: De cada tribo escolhei vós três homens, para que eu os envie, e eles se levantem e percorram a terra, e a demarquem segundo as suas heranças, e voltem a mim.

verses.original: וְהִֽתְחַלְּק֥וּ אֹתָ֖הּ לְשִׁבְעָ֣ה חֲלָקִ֑ים יְהוּדָ֞ה יַעֲמֹ֤ד עַל־ גְּבוּלוֹ֙ מִנֶּ֔גֶב וּבֵ֥ית יוֹסֵ֛ף יַעַמְד֥וּ עַל־ גְּבוּלָ֖ם מִצָּפֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiṯ·ḥal·lə·qū ’ō·ṯāh lə·šiḇ·‘āh ḥă·lā·qîm yə·hū·ḏāh ya·‘ă·mōḏ ‘al- gə·ḇū·lōw min·ne·ḡeḇ ū·ḇêṯ yō·w·sêp̄ ya·‘am·ḏū ‘al- gə·ḇū·lām miṣ·ṣā·p̄ō·wn
verses.literal: and divide the land into seven portions Judah shall remain in their territory in the south and the house of Joseph shall remain in their territory in the north
verses.literalPt: E dividi-la-ão em sete partes: Judá ficará no seu termo para o sul, e a casa de José ficará no seu termo para o norte.

verses.original: וְאַתֶּ֞ם תִּכְתְּב֤וּ אֶת־ הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ שִׁבְעָ֣ה חֲלָקִ֔ים וַֽהֲבֵאתֶ֥ם אֵלַ֖י הֵ֑נָּה וְיָרִ֨יתִי לָכֶ֤ם גּוֹרָל֙ פֹּ֔ה לִפְנֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tem tiḵ·tə·ḇū ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ šiḇ·‘āh ḥă·lā·qîm wa·hă·ḇê·ṯem ’ê·lay hên·nāh wə·yā·rî·ṯî lā·ḵem gō·w·rāl pōh lip̄·nê Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū
verses.literal: When you have mapped out the seven portions of land and brought it to me . . . I will cast lots for you here in the presence of the LORD our God
verses.literalPt: E vós demarcareis a terra em sete partes, e me trareis a mim aqui descrita, para que eu aqui lance as sortes perante o SENHOR nosso Deus,

verses.original: כִּ֠י אֵֽין־ חֵ֤לֶק לַלְוִיִּם֙ בְּקִרְבְּכֶ֔ם כִּֽי־ כְהֻנַּ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה נַחֲלָת֑וֹ וְגָ֡ד וּרְאוּבֵ֡ן וַחֲצִי֩ שֵׁ֨בֶט הַֽמְנַשֶּׁ֜ה לָקְח֣וּ נַחֲלָתָ֗ם מֵעֵ֤בֶר לַיַּרְדֵּן֙ מִזְרָ֔חָה אֲשֶׁר֙ נָתַ֣ן לָהֶ֔ם מֹשֶׁ֖ה עֶ֥בֶד יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’ên- ḥê·leq lal·wî·yim bə·qir·bə·ḵem kî- ḵə·hun·naṯ Yah·weh na·ḥă·lā·ṯōw wə·ḡāḏ ū·rə·’ū·ḇên wa·ḥă·ṣî šê·ḇeṭ ham·naš·šeh lā·qə·ḥū na·ḥă·lā·ṯām mê·‘ê·ḇer lay·yar·dên miz·rā·ḥāh ’ă·šer nā·ṯan lā·hem mō·šeh ‘e·ḇeḏ Yah·weh
verses.literal: The Levites however have no portion among you because their inheritance is the priesthood of the LORD And Gad Reuben and half the tribe of Manasseh have already received the inheritance that Moses the servant of the LORD gave them beyond the Jordan to the east
verses.literalPt: Porquanto os levitas não têm parte no meio de vós, porque o sacerdócio do SENHOR é a sua parte; e Gade, e Rúben, e a meia tribo de Manassés, receberam a sua herança além do Jordão para o oriente, a qual lhes deu Moisés, o servo do SENHOR.

verses.original: וַיָּקֻ֥מוּ הָאֲנָשִׁ֖ים וַיֵּלֵ֑כוּ וַיְצַ֣ו יְהוֹשֻׁ֡עַ אֶת־ הַהֹלְכִים֩ לִכְתֹּ֨ב אֶת־ הָאָ֜רֶץ לֵאמֹ֗ר לְ֠כוּ וְהִתְהַלְּכ֨וּ בָאָ֜רֶץ וְכִתְב֤וּ אוֹתָהּ֙ וְשׁ֣וּבוּ אֵלַ֔י וּ֠פֹה אַשְׁלִ֨יךְ לָכֶ֥ם גּוֹרָ֛ל לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה בְּשִׁלֹֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qu·mū hā·’ă·nā·šîm way·yê·lê·ḵū way·ṣaw yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ ’eṯ- ha·hō·lə·ḵîm liḵ·tōḇ ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ lê·mōr lə·ḵū wə·hiṯ·hal·lə·ḵū ḇā·’ā·reṣ wə·ḵiṯ·ḇū ’ō·w·ṯāh wə·šū·ḇū ’ê·lay ū·p̄ōh ’aš·lîḵ lā·ḵem gō·w·rāl lip̄·nê Yah·weh bə·ši·lōh
verses.literal: As the men got up to go out Joshua commanded them to map out the land saying Go and survey the land map it out and return to me Then I will cast lots for you here in Shiloh in the presence of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Então aqueles homens se levantaram e se foram; e Josué deu ordem aos que iam demarcar a terra, dizendo: Ide, e percorrei a terra, e demarcai-a, e então voltai a mim, e aqui vos lançarei as sortes perante o SENHOR, em Siló.

verses.original: וַיֵּלְכ֤וּ הָֽאֲנָשִׁים֙ וַיַּעַבְר֣וּ בָאָ֔רֶץ וַיִּכְתְּב֧וּהָ לֶֽעָרִ֛ים לְשִׁבְעָ֥ה חֲלָקִ֖ים עַל־ סֵ֑פֶר וַיָּבֹ֧אוּ אֶל־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֛עַ אֶל־ הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֖ה שִׁלֹֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·lə·ḵū hā·’ă·nā·šîm way·ya·‘aḇ·rū ḇā·’ā·reṣ way·yiḵ·tə·ḇū·hā le·‘ā·rîm lə·šiḇ·‘āh ḥă·lā·qîm ‘al- sê·p̄er way·yā·ḇō·’ū ’el- yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ ’el- ham·ma·ḥă·neh ši·lōh
verses.literal: So the men departed and went throughout the land mapping it city by city into seven portions Then they returned with the document to Joshua at the camp in Shiloh
verses.literalPt: Foram, pois, aqueles homens, e passaram pela terra, e a demarcaram, em sete partes segundo as cidades, descrevendo-a num livro; e voltaram a Josué, ao arraial em Siló.

verses.original: וַיַּשְׁלֵךְ֩ לָהֶ֨ם יְהוֹשֻׁ֧עַ גּוֹרָ֛ל בְּשִׁלֹ֖ה לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיְחַלֶּק־ שָׁ֨ם יְהוֹשֻׁ֧עַ אֶת־ הָאָ֛רֶץ לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל כְּמַחְלְקֹתָֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yaš·lêḵ lā·hem yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ gō·w·rāl bə·ši·lōh lip̄·nê Yah·weh way·ḥal·leq- šām yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ liḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl kə·maḥ·lə·qō·ṯām
verses.literal: And Joshua cast lots for them in the presence of the LORD at Shiloh where he distributed the land to the Israelites . . . according to their divisions
verses.literalPt: Então Josué lhes lançou as sortes em Siló, perante o SENHOR; e ali repartiu Josué a terra aos filhos de Israel, conforme às suas divisões.

verses.original: וַיַּ֗עַל גּוֹרַ֛ל מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי־ בִנְיָמִ֖ן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם וַיֵּצֵא֙ גְּב֣וּל גּֽוֹרָלָ֔ם בֵּ֚ין בְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וּבֵ֖ין בְּנֵ֥י יוֹסֵֽף׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘al gō·w·ral maṭ·ṭêh ḇə·nê- ḇin·yā·min lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯām way·yê·ṣê gə·ḇūl gō·w·rā·lām bên bə·nê yə·hū·ḏāh ū·ḇên bə·nê yō·w·sêp̄
verses.literal: The first lot came up for the clans of the tribe of Benjamin Their allotted territory lay between the tribes of Judah and Joseph
verses.literalPt: E tirou a sorte da tribo dos filhos de Benjamim, segundo as suas famílias; e coube-lhe o termo da sua sorte entre os filhos de Judá e os filhos de José.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֨י לָהֶ֧ם הַגְּב֛וּל לִפְאַ֥ת צָפ֖וֹנָה מִן־ הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן וְעָלָ֣ה הַגְּבוּל֩ אֶל־ כֶּ֨תֶף יְרִיח֜וֹ מִצָּפ֗וֹן וְעָלָ֤ה בָהָר֙ יָ֔מָּה וְהָיָה תֹּֽצְאֹתָ֔יו מִדְבַּ֖רָה בֵּ֥ית אָֽוֶן׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî lā·hem hag·gə·ḇūl lip̄·’aṯ ṣā·p̄ō·w·nāh min- hay·yar·dên wə·‘ā·lāh hag·gə·ḇūl ’el- ke·ṯep̄ yə·rî·ḥōw miṣ·ṣā·p̄ō·wn wə·‘ā·lāh ḇā·hār yām·māh wə·hå̄·yå̄h tō·ṣə·’ō·ṯāw miḏ·ba·rāh bêṯ ’ā·wen
verses.literal: On the north side their border began at the Jordan went up . . . past the northern slope of Jericho headed west through the hill country and came out . . . at the wilderness of Beth-aven
verses.literalPt: E o seu termo foi para o lado do norte, desde o Jordão; e sobe aquele termo ao lado de Jericó para o norte, e sobe pela montanha para o ocidente, terminando no deserto de Bete-Áven.

verses.original: וְעָבַר֩ מִשָּׁ֨ם הַגְּב֜וּל ל֗וּזָה אֶל־ כֶּ֤תֶף ל֙וּזָה֙ נֶ֔גְבָּה הִ֖יא בֵּֽית־ אֵ֑ל וְיָרַ֤ד הַגְּבוּל֙ עַטְר֣וֹת אַדָּ֔ר עַל־ הָהָ֕ר אֲשֶׁ֛ר מִנֶּ֥גֶב לְבֵית־ חֹר֖וֹן תַּחְתּֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·ḇar miš·šām hag·gə·ḇūl lū·zāh ’el- ke·ṯep̄ lū·zāh neḡ·bāh hî bêṯ- ’êl wə·yā·raḏ hag·gə·ḇūl ‘aṭ·rō·wṯ ’ad·dār ‘al- hā·hār ’ă·šer min·ne·ḡeḇ lə·ḇêṯ- ḥō·rō·wn taḥ·tō·wn
verses.literal: From there the border crossed over to the southern slope of Luz (that is Bethel and went down to Ataroth-addar on the hill south of Lower Beth-horon
verses.literalPt: E dali passa este termo a Luz, ao lado de Luz (que é Betel), para o sul; e desce a Atarote-Adar, ao pé do monte que está do lado do sul de Bete-Horom de baixo;

verses.original: וְתָאַ֣ר הַגְּבוּל֩ וְנָסַ֨ב לִפְאַת־ יָ֜ם נֶ֗גְבָּה מִן־ הָהָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י בֵית־ חֹרוֹן֮ נֶגְבָּה֒ וְהָיָה תֹֽצְאֹתָ֗יו אֶל־ קִרְיַת־ בַּ֙עַל֙ הִ֚יא קִרְיַ֣ת יְעָרִ֔ים עִ֖יר בְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה זֹ֖את פְּאַת־ יָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ṯā·’ar hag·gə·ḇūl wə·nā·saḇ lip̄·’aṯ- yām neḡ·bāh min- hā·hār ’ă·šer ‘al- pə·nê ḇêṯ- ḥō·rō·wn neḡ·bāh wə·hå̄·yå̄h ṯō·ṣə·’ō·ṯāw ’el- qir·yaṯ- ba·‘al hî qir·yaṯ yə·‘ā·rîm ‘îr bə·nê yə·hū·ḏāh zōṯ pə·’aṯ- yām
verses.literal: On the west side the border curved southward from the hill facing . . . Beth-horon on the south and came out . . . at Kiriath-baal (that is Kiriath-jearim a city of the sons of Judah This was the western side
verses.literalPt: E vai este termo e volta ao lado do ocidente para o sul do monte que está defronte de Bete-Horom, para o sul, terminando em Quiriate-Baal (que é Quiriate-Jearim), cidade dos filhos de Judá; esta é a sua extensão para o ocidente.

verses.original: וּפְאַת־ נֶ֕גְבָּה מִקְצֵ֖ה קִרְיַ֣ת יְעָרִ֑ים וְיָצָ֤א הַגְּבוּל֙ יָ֔מָּה וְיָצָ֕א אֶל־ מַעְיַ֖ן מֵ֥י נֶפְתּֽוֹחַ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·p̄ə·’aṯ- neḡ·bāh miq·ṣêh qir·yaṯ yə·‘ā·rîm wə·yā·ṣā hag·gə·ḇūl yām·māh wə·yā·ṣā ’el- ma‘·yan mê nep̄·tō·w·aḥ
verses.literal: On the south side the border began at the outskirts of Kiriath-jearim and extended westward to the spring at the Waters of Nephtoah
verses.literalPt: E a sua extensão para o sul começa na extremidade de Quiriate-Jearim; e vai este termo ao ocidente e segue até à fonte das águas de Neftoa.

verses.original: וְיָרַ֨ד הַגְּב֜וּל אֶל־ קְצֵ֣ה הָהָ֗ר אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל־ פְּנֵי֙ גֵּ֣י בֶן־ הִנֹּ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֛ר בְּעֵ֥מֶק רְפָאִ֖ים צָפ֑וֹנָה וְיָרַד֩ גֵּ֨י הִנֹּ֜ם אֶל־ כֶּ֤תֶף הַיְבוּסִי֙ נֶ֔גְבָּה וְיָרַ֖ד עֵ֥ין רֹגֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·raḏ hag·gə·ḇūl ’el- qə·ṣêh hā·hār ’ă·šer ‘al- pə·nê gê ḇen- hin·nōm ’ă·šer bə·‘ê·meq rə·p̄ā·’îm ṣā·p̄ō·w·nāh wə·yā·raḏ gê hin·nōm ’el- ke·ṯep̄ hay·ḇū·sî neḡ·bāh wə·yā·raḏ ‘ên rō·ḡêl
verses.literal: Then it went down to the foot of the hill that faces . . . the Valley of Ben-hinnom . . . . . . at the northern end of the Valley of Rephaim and ran down the Valley of Hinnom . . . toward the southern slope of the Jebusites and downward to En-rogel
verses.literalPt: E desce este termo até à extremidade do monte que está defronte do vale do filho de Hinom, que está no vale dos refains para o norte, e desce pelo vale de Hinom do lado dos jebuseus para o sul; e então desce a En-Rogel;

verses.original: וְתָאַ֣ר מִצָּפ֗וֹן וְיָצָא֙ עֵ֣ין שֶׁ֔מֶשׁ וְיָצָא֙ אֶל־ גְּלִיל֔וֹת אֲשֶׁר־ נֹ֖כַח מַעֲלֵ֣ה אֲדֻמִּ֑ים וְיָרַ֕ד אֶ֥בֶן בֹּ֖הַן בֶּן־ רְאוּבֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ṯā·’ar miṣ·ṣā·p̄ō·wn wə·yā·ṣā ‘ên še·meš wə·yā·ṣā ’el- gə·lî·lō·wṯ ’ă·šer- nō·ḵaḥ ma·‘ă·lêh ’ă·ḏum·mîm wə·yā·raḏ ’e·ḇen bō·han ben- rə·’ū·ḇên
verses.literal: From there it curved northward and proceeded to En-shemesh . . . and on to Geliloth facing the Ascent of Adummim and continued down to the Stone of Bohan son of Reuben
verses.literalPt: E vai desde o norte, e chega a En-Semes; e dali sai a Gelilote, que está defronte da subida de Adumim, e desce à pedra de Boã, filho de Rúben;

verses.original: וְעָבַ֛ר אֶל־ כֶּ֥תֶף מוּל־ הָֽעֲרָבָ֖ה צָפ֑וֹנָה וְיָרַ֖ד הָעֲרָבָֽתָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·ḇar ’el- ke·ṯep̄ mūl- hā·‘ă·rā·ḇāh ṣā·p̄ō·w·nāh wə·yā·raḏ hā·‘ă·rā·ḇā·ṯāh
verses.literal: Then it went on to the northern slope of Beth-arabah and went down into the valley
verses.literalPt: E passa até ao lado, defronte de Arabá, para o norte, e desce a Arabá.

verses.original: וְעָבַ֨ר הַגְּב֜וּל אֶל־ כֶּ֣תֶף בֵּית־ חָגְלָה֮ צָפוֹנָה֒ וְהָיָה תֹּצְאוֹתָיו הַגְּב֗וּל אֶל־ לְשׁ֤וֹן יָם־ הַמֶּ֙לַח֙ צָפ֔וֹנָה אֶל־ קְצֵ֥ה הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן נֶ֑גְבָּה זֶ֖ה גְּב֥וּל נֶֽגֶב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·ḇar hag·gə·ḇūl ’el- ke·ṯep̄ bêṯ- ḥā·ḡə·lāh ṣā·p̄ō·w·nāh wə·hå̄·yå̄h tō·ṣə·ʾō·ṯå̄w hag·gə·ḇūl ’el- lə·šō·wn yām- ham·me·laḥ ṣā·p̄ō·w·nāh ’el- qə·ṣêh hay·yar·dên neḡ·bāh zeh gə·ḇūl ne·ḡeḇ
verses.literal: The border continued to the northern slope of Beth-hoglah and came out . . . at the northern bay of the Salt Sea . . . at the mouth . . . of the Jordan This . . . was the southern border
verses.literalPt: Passa mais este termo até ao lado de Bete-Hogla, para o norte, saindo esse termo na baía do Mar Salgado, para o norte, na extremidade do Jordão, para o sul; este é o termo do sul.

verses.original: וְהַיַּרְדֵּ֥ן יִגְבֹּל־ אֹת֖וֹ לִפְאַת־ קֵ֑דְמָה זֹ֡את נַחֲלַת֩ בְּנֵ֨י בִנְיָמִ֧ן לִגְבֽוּלֹתֶ֛יהָ סָבִ֖יב לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hay·yar·dên yiḡ·bōl- ’ō·ṯōw lip̄·’aṯ- qê·ḏə·māh zōṯ na·ḥă·laṯ bə·nê ḇin·yā·min liḡ·ḇū·lō·ṯe·hā sā·ḇîḇ lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯām
verses.literal: On the east side the border was the Jordan These were the borders around the inheritance of the clans of the tribe of Benjamin
verses.literalPt: E o Jordão será seu termo do lado do oriente; esta é a herança dos filhos de Benjamim, nos seus termos em redor, segundo as suas famílias.

verses.original: וְהָי֣וּ הֶֽעָרִ֗ים לְמַטֵּ֛ה בְּנֵ֥י בִנְיָמִ֖ן לְמִשְׁפְּחֽוֹתֵיהֶ֑ם יְרִיח֥וֹ וּבֵית־ חָגְלָ֖ה וְעֵ֥מֶק קְצִֽיץ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yū he·‘ā·rîm lə·maṭ·ṭêh bə·nê ḇin·yā·min lə·miš·pə·ḥō·w·ṯê·hem yə·rî·ḥōw ū·ḇêṯ- ḥā·ḡə·lāh wə·‘ê·meq qə·ṣîṣ
verses.literal: These were the cities of the clans of the tribe of Benjamin Jericho Beth-hoglah . . . Emek-keziz
verses.literalPt: E as cidades da tribo dos filhos de Benjamim, segundo as suas famílias, são: Jericó, e Bete-Hogla, e Emeque-Queziz,

verses.original: וּבֵ֧ית הָֽעֲרָבָ֛ה וּצְמָרַ֖יִם וּבֵֽית־ אֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇêṯ hā·‘ă·rā·ḇāh ū·ṣə·mā·ra·yim ū·ḇêṯ- ’êl
verses.literal: Beth-arabah Zemaraim Bethel
verses.literalPt: E Bete-Arabá, e Zemaraim, e Betel,

verses.original: וְהָעַוִּ֥ים וְהַפָּרָ֖ה וְעָפְרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·‘aw·wîm wə·hap·pā·rāh wə·‘ā·p̄ə·rāh
verses.literal: Avvim Parah Ophrah
verses.literalPt: E Avim, e Pará, e Ofra,

verses.original: וּכְפַ֧ר הָעַמֹּנִי וְהָֽעָפְנִ֖י וָגָ֑בַע עָרִ֥ים שְׁתֵּים־ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḵə·p̄ar hå̄·ʿam·mō·nī wə·hā·‘ā·p̄ə·nî wā·ḡā·ḇa‘ ‘ā·rîm šə·têm- ‘eś·rêh wə·ḥaṣ·rê·hen
verses.literal: Chephar-ammoni Ophni and Geba twelve . . . cities along with their villages
verses.literalPt: E Quefar-Amonai, e Ofni e Gaba: doze cidades e as suas aldeias;

verses.original: גִּבְע֥וֹן וְהָֽרָמָ֖ה וּבְאֵרֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: giḇ·‘ō·wn wə·hā·rā·māh ū·ḇə·’ê·rō·wṯ
verses.literal: Gibeon Ramah Beeroth
verses.literalPt: Gibeão, e Ramá e Beerote,

verses.original: וְהַמִּצְפֶּ֥ה וְהַכְּפִירָ֖ה וְהַמֹּצָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ham·miṣ·peh wə·hak·kə·p̄î·rāh wə·ham·mō·ṣāh
verses.literal: Mizpeh Chephirah Mozah
verses.literalPt: E Mizpá, e Cefira e Moza,

verses.original: וְרֶ֥קֶם וְיִרְפְּאֵ֖ל וְתַרְאֲלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·re·qem wə·yir·pə·’êl wə·ṯar·’ă·lāh
verses.literal: Rekem Irpeel Taralah
verses.literalPt: E Requém e Irpeel, e Tarala,

verses.original: וְצֵלַ֡ע הָאֶ֜לֶף וְהַיְבוּסִ֨י הִ֤יא יְרֽוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ גִּבְעַ֣ת קִרְיַ֔ת עָרִ֥ים אַרְבַּֽע־ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה וְחַצְרֵיהֶ֑ן זֹ֛את נַֽחֲלַ֥ת בְּנֵֽי־ בִנְיָמִ֖ן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·ṣê·la‘ hā·’e·lep̄ wə·hay·ḇū·sî hî yə·rū·šā·lim giḇ·‘aṯ qir·yaṯ ‘ā·rîm ’ar·ba‘- ‘eś·rêh wə·ḥaṣ·rê·hen zōṯ na·ḥă·laṯ bə·nê- ḇin·yā·min lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯām
verses.literal: Zelah Haeleph Jebus (that is Jerusalem Gibeah and Kiriath-jearim fourteen . . . cities along with their villages This was the inheritance of the clans of the tribe of Benjamin
verses.literalPt: E Zela, Elefe, e Jebus (esta é Jerusalém), Gibeá e Quiriate: catorze cidades com as suas aldeias; esta é a herança dos filhos de Benjamim, segundo as suas famílias.
